# Pacer AI

> Pacer AI is a bottom-up sales forecasting and bottom-up planning agent for sales leaders. Make plan with confidence. Forecasts and plans update in real time and reconcile to Finance. Built for CROs, VP Sales, RevOps and CFOs at B2B companies with complex GTM motions and $10M or more in recurring revenue. Seats are Rep, Manager and SLT. Services start at $15,000.

This file is the copy to publish at https://getpacerai.com/llms.txt. The live file is generated by Yoast and was not overwritten by this change.

## Pages

- [Home](https://getpacerai.com/): Bottom-up sales forecasting and planning for sales leaders. Make plan with confidence. Updated in real time. Reconciled to Finance.
- [Bottom-up sales forecasting](https://getpacerai.com/bottom-up-sales-forecasting/): The forecast is built from booked revenue and open pipeline at the account, product and rep.
- [Bottom-up sales planning](https://getpacerai.com/bottom-up-sales-planning/): The plan is built from the same accounts, for Rep, Manager and SLT seats.
- [Pricing](https://getpacerai.com/pricing/): Rep pacing $100, Manager pacing $500, and SLT pacing and planning $1,000 per user a month. SLT installation $5,000. Services from $15,000.
- [Compare](https://getpacerai.com/compare/): Pacer AI vs Clari Forecast, Gong Forecast and Anaplan. Last reviewed Nov 2026.
- [Pacer AI vs Clari Forecast](https://getpacerai.com/compare/pacer-ai-vs-clari/): Clari is now part of Salesloft. clari.com redirects there. Clari Forecast keeps the Clari name.
- [Pacer AI vs Gong Forecast](https://getpacerai.com/compare/pacer-ai-vs-gong-forecast/): Gong rolls up submitted forecast numbers. Pacer builds the number from bookings and pipeline.
- [Pacer AI vs Anaplan](https://getpacerai.com/compare/pacer-ai-vs-anaplan/): Anaplan is a connected planning platform. Pacer is the agent for the sales forecast and the sales plan.
- [Demo](https://getpacerai.com/demo-connect/): Free demo in Claude on a synthetic company.
- [Team](https://getpacerai.com/team/): Will Sullivan, founder. Former PwC M&A advisor and West Point graduate.
